drafted_from: tool:route-to-the-owner-that-answers row in tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/tool-rows.json, its code in tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ and tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/test/tool.test.mjs; the answers were produced by running the tool against a stand-in model server
start_here: Say to your AI: "Who holds the answer to 'who sells flour near the shop': the oven log or the supplier book? Ask my local model." It runs the router and tells you which place to look first and how.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads one request file naming your owners and the question, and answers which owner to look in.
instructions: 1. Write your owners: [{id, holds, ask (how to look there), for_example: [questions that owner answers]}], at least two.

2. Write /work/judge/request.json with owners, looking_for, providers, and your bars: pass_when_share_correct (0 to 1), confidence_bands [{at_least, then}] and band_when_confidence_unknown. These bars are yours; the tool refuses without them.
3. Say "Route my question". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: node tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ask-a-small-model.mjs route < /work/judge/request.json.
4. Read the last line: result.go_to (the owner), result.how, result.what_to_do (the band your bars draw) and result.then_try (the next owners).

worked_examples.title: A flour question goes to the supplier book
worked_examples.ask: Where do I look for who sells flour near the shop?
worked_examples.given: From tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/test/tool.test.mjs (test "route: the owner whose examples match is picked..."), run for real against a stand-in model server that picks the second owner for questions mentioning flour. Request: {"owners": [{"id": "oven-log", "holds": "what was baked and when", "ask": "read the oven log", "for_example": ["when did the rye come out", "how many loaves did the oven take"]}, {"id": "supplier-book", "holds": "who sells flour and at what price", "ask": "open the supplier book", "for_example": ["who sells the cheapest flour", "what does a sack of flour cost"]}], "looking_for": "who sells flour near the shop", "providers": [{"via": "locally-served", "endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:11434", "timeout_seconds": 30, "protocol": "ollama"}], "pass_when_share_correct": 0.9, "confidence_bands": [{"at_least": 0.6, "then": "go-there"}, {"at_least": 0, "then": "look-in-the-top-two"}], "band_when_confidence_unknown": "look-in-the-top-two"}. Command: node tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ask-a-small-model.mjs route < /work/judge/request.json
worked_examples.hands_back: Last line: {"result": {"looking_for": "who sells flour near the shop", "go_to": "supplier-book", "confidence": null, "what_to_do": "look-in-the-top-two", "how": "open the supplier book", "then_try": []}}. The model's confidence is unknown (a chat model gives none), so the band_when_confidence_unknown applies.
